Package index

Start here

SurveyStudio opens an instrument and takes it through every stage below, with no code. ?surveyframe is the map of the package, and sframe_demo(“first_survey”) is a whole survey to start from.

surveyframe surveyframe-package
surveyframe: Survey Instrument Workflows for R
launch_studio()
Launch the SurveyStudio interface

Design

Make the instrument: its questions, choice sets, scales, branching and attention checks, saved as a portable .sframe file. In SurveyBuilder: the Build mode. In code: sframe_instrument() and the makers listed here, then write_sframe().

launch_builder()
Launch the surveyframe visual survey builder
sframe_instrument()
Create a survey instrument object
sframe_get_study()
The study an instrument serves
sframe_sampling_methods()
Sampling methods a study can declare
sframe_item()
Define a survey item
sframe_choice_set()
Define a reusable choice set
sframe_scale()
Define a scored scale
sframe_branch()
Define a branching rule
sframe_attention_check()
Define a design-time survey check
sframe_conjoint_design()
Declare a choice-experiment (conjoint) design
write_sframe()
Write an instrument to a .sframe file
read_sframe()
Read an instrument from a .sframe file
validate_sframe()
Validate an instrument object
sframe_validation
Report on a validation result
as_sframe()
Coerce to an instrument

Plan

Declare the analysis before the data arrive, so the report shows what was planned and what was run. In SurveyBuilder: the Plan mode. In SurveyStudio: Plan, or the Analyse screen. In code: sframe_plan(x) <- plan.

sframe_plan()
Get the pre-declared analysis plan
`sframe_plan<-`()
Set the pre-declared analysis plan
sframe_sample_size_plan()
Sample-size and power planning helper

Preview

See the survey as a respondent meets it, with nothing collected. In SurveyStudio: the Preview screen. In code: preview_survey().

preview_survey()
Preview a survey as a respondent sees it
run_survey()
Render a survey from an instrument object

Collect

Send the survey out: a standalone HTML page, optionally saving answers to a Google Sheet, or a Shiny module inside your own app. In SurveyBuilder: Export survey, with the Google Sheets settings. In code: export_survey().

export_survey()
Export a self-contained static HTML survey
export_google_sheet()
Export a survey instrument to Google Sheets collection format
sframe_survey_ui()
Shiny module UI for an embedded survey
sframe_survey_server()
Shiny module server for an embedded survey

Responses

Read the answers back against the instrument, check their quality, and export them with labels for other software. In SurveyStudio: the Responses and Quality screens. In code: read_responses().

read_responses()
Read and validate survey responses
read_sheet_responses()
Read survey responses from a Google Sheet
export_responses()
Write responses to SPSS or Stata with the labels attached
sframe_quality_results()
Generate a data quality report for survey responses
sframe_missing_data_results()
Missing-data report
sframe_outlier_results()
Flag univariate and multivariate outliers

Analyse

Score the scales and run the plan, block by block. In SurveyStudio: the Explore, Reliability and Analyse screens. In code: run_analysis_plan().

run_analysis_plan()
Run a pre-planned analysis from an instrument's analysis plan
score_scales()
Score defined scales from survey responses
sframe_descriptives_results()
Descriptive statistics report
sframe_reliability_results()
Estimate scale reliability from item responses
sframe_item_results()
Generate item-level diagnostics
sframe_efa_readiness_results()
Prepare a survey instrument for exploratory factor analysis
sframe_efa_solution()
Estimate an exploratory factor solution
sframe_validity_results()
Validity report for construct models
sframe_assumption_results()
Assumption-check report
sframe_posthoc_results()
Post-hoc and pairwise comparison report

Report

Write up what was run: an HTML, PDF, Word or OpenDocument report or its Quarto source, a codebook, the figures, and the R code behind each result. In SurveyStudio: the Report screen. In code: render_report().

render_report()
Render a reproducible survey report
sframe_report_source()
Recompute and check a report source folder
render_results()
Render analysis results to a formatted HTML report
sframe_reports
Choosing a report
sframe_format_result()
Render one analysis result as the report does
sframe_codebook()
Generate a survey codebook from an instrument object
sframe_save_figures()
Save the charts from an analysis plan as files
sframe_analysis_qmd()
Write a Quarto analysis notebook for any instrument

References

Cite the works an instrument draws on. The references travel in the .sframe file and the report lists each one once, at the end. In SurveyStudio: the References screen. In code: sframe_add_references().

sframe_reference()
Create a reference
read_bibtex()
Read references from BibTeX
sframe_add_references()
Add references to an instrument
sframe_get_references()
List an instrument's references
sframe_bibliography()
Write a bibliography as CSL-JSON

Amendments

Change an instrument mid-study, on the record: each amendment is logged with its reason and the hash it replaced. In SurveyStudio: the Amendments screen. In code: amend_sframe().

amend_sframe()
Record a disclosed amendment to an instrument
sframe_get_amendments()
Read an instrument's amendment log
sframe_drop_items()
Drop items from scales or models
sframe_item_flags()
Items past the usual cut-offs in a measurement result
sframe_link_git_commit()
Link an instrument to its current Git commit

Models and syntax

Declare constructs, paths and covariances, and generate lavaan, seminr and psych syntax from the instrument.

sframe_construct()
Define a latent or composite construct
sframe_path()

sframe_covariance()

sframe_indirect_effect()

sframe_add_model()
Add a model specification to an instrument

sframe_model_json()
Serialise a model specification to JSON
sframe_model_outline()

sframe_syntax_efa()

sframe_syntax_sem()

sframe_syntax_pls()
Generate seminr PLS-SEM syntax
sframe_syntax_result()

Decision analysis

Multi-criteria decision analysis. The 10 methods run through the analysis plan like any other, so the functions here assemble their input and test how stable a ranking is.

sframe_sensitivity_analysis()
Test how far a decision ranking moves when the weights are perturbed
sframe_assemble_pairwise()
Assemble per-respondent comparison matrices
sframe_aggregate_judgements()
Aggregate individual judgement matrices
sframe_collected_weights()
Criterion weights collected from respondents
sframe_rated_matrix()
Build a performance matrix from rated matrix items
sframe_decision_options()
Normalise the decision options of an analysis-plan block
sframe_dematel_compute()
The DEMATEL total-relation classification

Text analysis

Open-ended answers: term and n-gram frequency, keyword in context, and quote extraction.

sframe_clean_text()
Clean open-ended text responses for analysis
sframe_term_frequency()
Term frequency for open-ended text
sframe_ngram_frequency()
N-gram frequency for open-ended text
sframe_term_context()
Keyword-in-context concordance for open-ended text
sframe_extract_quotes()
Extract representative quotes for each STM topic

Confidence intervals

Base-R bootstrap and effect-size confidence intervals, reused across the inferential runners.

sframe_bootstrap_ci()
Percentile bootstrap confidence interval for a statistic
sframe_cohens_d_ci()
Bootstrap confidence interval for Cohen's d
sframe_cramers_v_ci()
Bootstrap confidence interval for Cramer's V
sframe_eta_sq_ci()
Bootstrap confidence interval for eta squared

Demos

22 small teaching demos, each doing one job, and 2 larger reference datasets. Each comes with an instrument and response data, and the teaching demos with a codebook and the results surveyframe produced. See the “Learn by example” article.

sframe_list_demos()
List the bundled demos
sframe_demo()
Load one bundled demo
sframe_demo_qmd()
Copy a demo's Quarto notebook so you can run and change it

Format a result table's cells as an APA 7 report prints them
